meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 处理 Git 提交和历史问题时会更严谨:先查看仓库状态,把请求分成提交、变基、历史调查等类型,再按规则暂存、提交、改写历史或查找证据,最后报告结果和未提交文件。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交代码或调查 Git 历史时触发,比如请求提交改动、合并提交、查找某行代码是谁写的等。普通代码编辑不触发,除非用户明确要求。

say.text: 帮我把当前改动按逻辑分成几次提交
say.note: 会先检查 diff,再分组建提交

say.text: 查一下这行代码是谁改的
say.note: 会用 git blame 定位并给出证据

say.text: 把最近三个提交合并成一个
say.note: 进入 rebase 流程,执行前会确认

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude handles Git commits and history investigations more rigorously: it checks repo state, classifies the request into commit/rebase/history/status, then stages, commits, rewrites history, or gathers evidence per rules, and reports results plus remaining uncommitted files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs a commit or Git-history investigation, such as committing changes, squashing commits, or finding who changed a line. Ordinary code edits don't trigger unless the user explicitly asks.

say_en.text: Split my current changes into logical commits
say_en.note: It inspects the diff first, then commits in groups

say_en.text: Find out who changed this line of code
say_en.note: It uses git blame and shows the evidence

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one
say_en.note: It starts a rebase and confirms before acting
